verdict.rationale: Blaxel's docs say sandboxes resume from standby in under 25ms, even after weeks of inactivity, and that new sandboxes deploy from images "in seconds". Together these cover the sub-second-to-few-second startup the story asks for. Missing for 10: a precise documented cold-start figure for fresh sandbox creation (as opposed to standby resume), and independent or hands-on benchmarks corroborating the vendor's latency claims.
